entities.summary: Kiến Trung Palace is a building within the Imperial City of Huế, the former imperial capital of Vietnam. It was the residence of the last two emperors of the Nguyễn dynasty. In 1947, the palace was destroyed by the Viet Minh during the Indochina Wars.
